artworks.title: Benjamin Fisher
artworks.medium: black, white, and red chalk on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sabatino J. Abate, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a head-and-shoulders portrait. He is slightly positioned to the right, facing forward. The man has a high forehead, slightly furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, and light, thin hair styled back. He is wearing a collared garment with a high white neckcloth tied around his neck. The background is simple and neutral-toned.

artworks.title: Mrs. Benjamin Fisher
artworks.medium: black, white, and red chalk on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sabatino J. Abate, Jr.
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of an elderly woman shown from the shoulders up. She is facing the viewer with a neutral expression. She has light-colored hair mostly covered by a white bonnet tied under her chin. The woman wears a light-colored garment around her shoulders and neck. The background is soft and neutral, providing no context.

artworks.title: Diana and Her Nymphs Bathing
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: This is a drawing of five figures engaging in various activities near a water body. The individuals are depicted in different poses, some reaching out while others interact playfully. The setting appears to be a natural area with greenery in the background. The use of soft lines and gentle colors gives the image a serene quality. The attention to posture and movement conveys dynamism and liveliness.

artworks.title: Canto III, Verse 201
artworks.artist: William Blake after Mary Ann Flaxman
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: design size: 10.4 x 7.9 cm (4 1/8 x 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure in a flowing gown encountering mythical beings. The scene shows the figure standing with folded hands, possibly in a gesture of reverence or contemplation, facing a background with fantastical creatures emerging. These creatures include a hybrid being with the torso and head of a human and a coiled serpent-like lower body. The background is intricately detailed with swirling textures, creating a sense of movement and depth. The composition is framed within a larger page with annotations at the bottom specifying "Canto III Verse 201," alongside names and a publication date.

artworks.title: Canto IV, Verse 294
artworks.artist: William Blake after Mary Ann Flaxman
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: design size: 10.3 x 8 cm (4 1/16 x 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in the foreground of an illustration within a book. The man is on the left, wearing a fur-covered outfit and holding a long, coiled object. He has a thick beard and bushy eyebrows. Next to him stands a woman with wavy hair wearing a flowing gown. Behind them is a group of people in elaborate attire, with one person wearing a pointed hat. The background shows an architectural setting with archways and curtains. The book's page indicates it is an illustration for Canto VI, Verse 294, dated May 1, 1803, with the artist and publishers credited below the image.

artworks.title: Canto I
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: design size: 10.5 x 6.9 cm (4 1/8 x 2 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: This is a drawing with mythical themes. The picture features several nude, muscular figures with draped cloth, surrounding a large, ominous central face within a rock or mountain. The figures are depicted in active poses, reaching out and grappling with each other or the environment. Above, there is a human-like face emerging from clouds with wings on each side. Horizontal lines in the background add texture and depth. The detailed engraving and shading techniques suggest a narrative scene possibly referencing a myth or story.

artworks.title: Illustration for Canto IV
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: design size: 10.3 x 6.8 cm (4 1/16 x 2 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a scene with two figures and an urn on a table. The central figure is standing, holding a piece of paper and wearing a bonnet and robe-like garment. Next to this figure is an elderly figure bent over slightly with a cane, positioned near a draped table holding a large, ornate urn with handles. The background features a draped curtain with decorative swags.

artworks.title: Illustration for Canto II
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: design size: 10.8 x 7.2 cm (4 1/4 x 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The engraving shows two individuals in an oval frame. On the left, an older man sits in a chair with one arm resting on the armrest and holding a cane. He has shoulder-length curly hair and wears 18th-century attire. On the right, there is a younger woman leaning slightly towards the man. She has curly hair with decorations, wears a long gown, and appears to be reaching towards the man. The background features a textured wall with a floral design.

artworks.title: Illustration for Canto V
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: design size: 10.6 x 7.1 cm (4 3/16 x 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: Four women are depicted in the image, dressed in flowing classical garments. Three of the women stand together, while the fourth woman sits in the foreground. The standing women have their hair styled up and delicate facial features. The sitting woman has her hair in buns and appears to be tending to a potted plant. The scene is set in an oval border against a patterned background with a decorative motif at the top. The engraving is signed by the artist with publisher's details provided below the image.

artworks.title: "Une de ces mines pudibones"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals on a street or promenade. In the foreground to the left, a woman is shown from the back, wearing a voluminous dress with a fitted bodice adorned with horizontal stripes and a hat featuring ribbons or flowers. To the right, a man stands facing her, dressed in a formal suit, holding a walking cane and umbrella. A figure sits in the background on a bench or balustrade, against a cityscape under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Phrosine and Melidore
artworks.medium: etching, stipple, roulette, and engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict

artworks.title: Saint Cecilia Accompanied by Heavenly Musicians
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 31.6 x 37.2 cm (12 7/16 x 14 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals, with their upper bodies and faces clearly visible. The central figure is seated upright, looking slightly upward with wide eyes. She has curly hair, mostly covered by a large, ornate turban or head wrap. Her attire is elaborate, with a patterned dress featuring a low neckline and a decorative, circular brooch at the chest. To her left, a figure with feathered wings plays a wind instrument while glancing towards her. This figure also has short, curly hair and wears draped fabric. On her right, another winged figure leans in closely with curly hair and holds a lute or similar stringed instrument. A fourth person peers over the central figure's shoulder, looking towards the music book held open on the table. The background is a draped curtain, with the entire scene lit in a chiaroscuro effect, casting deep shadows and highlighting the figures and the objects around them, such as a candle, a violin, and the open book.

artworks.title: Fedoa Americana pectore ruso
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird perched on a branch. The artwork features a bird with a pink-hued neck and a darker brown body adorned with spots, sitting on a thin, bare branch. The bird has a long tail that extends downwards. The background is simple and free of distractions, focusing on the bird and branches. The branch the bird is perched on has a few sprouting leaves. The painting has a use of color and detail, presenting a depiction of the bird.

artworks.title: The Red-Headed Finch from Surinam
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird perched on a branch. The bird has a red head, green wings, a blue chest, and yellow accents. It is sitting on a gray branch with a background of foliage in shades of brown and green. The style is detailed and precise, intended to accurately represent the bird. The accompanying text identifies it as a "red-headed finch from Surinam".

artworks.title: Two Birds, One with Very Long Tailfeathers, and Blue Butterfly
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds perched on branches, with a blue butterfly in the scene. The artwork depicts a scene with a bird below, featuring speckled plumage of brown and orange tones, its beak open. Above this bird, another one perches on a twig, showcasing long tail feathers and a breast with a reddish spot. The twig extends from a branch with green leaves. A delicate blue butterfly hovers nearby. The painting has a realistic style, capturing details of each subject.

artworks.title: The Black and White Crested Bird of Paradise
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird perched on a branch with another bird flying in the background. The painting features a bird with a black crest and a brown body, detailed patterns on its wings. The bird is on a green and brown branch with leaves. Its tail feathers are long. In the background, another bird with elongated tail feathers is flying.

artworks.title: Brown Speckled Bird
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a bird standing on grass. The bird has brown plumage with white speckles on its chest and wings, and its tail is extended upwards. Its beak is open as if calling out. The bird stands alert with one leg slightly lifted, on uneven terrain with sparse greenery and a few plants sprouting around it. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Green Bird with Red Throat and Brown and Orange Bird
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds perched on branches. The upper bird has green plumage with a red throat and a long, slender beak. The lower bird has brown and rust hues, a slender body, and a yellow patch on its side. Both birds are perched on branches of a bare, gnarled tree. In the background, there is greenery with a small mound of grass and a partial wooden fence.

artworks.title: Red and Black Bird
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird perched on a branch. The bird has red plumage on its head and upper body, transitioning to darker feathers in the wings and tail, and soft grays in between. It stands on a gnarled branch against a plain background. The bird has a black beak and appears alert. The branch is textured with bark and has a subtle green tinge, and there are small foliage details at the base.

artworks.title: Black and White Water-Fowl with Blue Throat
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird holding a fish in its beak. The bird is portrayed on a patch of green grass, with its body slightly turned and head lifted up. Its plumage consists of alternating black and white feathers, transitioning into a blue neck. The bird's feathers are detailed, and the surroundings include small clusters of leaves. The composition highlights the bird's success in catching the fish.

artworks.title: Brown Bird with a Butterfly
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird perched on a branch with a butterfly nearby. The bird is depicted in profile, with detailed feathers from its head to its tail. Its beak is partially open. The branch is textured and extends from foliage at the bottom. A butterfly with delicate wings is to the left. The background is minimally detailed.

artworks.title: Pygmy Anteater
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a creature with long claws perched on a branch. The creature has a long, slender body covered in brownish fur with a stripe running along its back. It grips the branch with its long claws, and its elongated tail curls around beneath it. The branch appears weathered and is decorated with small green leaves.

artworks.title: Pica grisea Brasiliensis
artworks.artist: Johann Michael Seligmann after George Edwards
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird perched on a branch alongside a moth. The bird has detailed plumage, perched on a branch with green foliage at the base. The bird is shown with an emphasis on the texture and color variation of its feathers, displaying shades of gray and darker tones with a bluish-green spot near its eye. The branch it sits on is detailed, grounding the subject in a natural environment. To the top left of the bird is a large moth with vibrant orange and black coloring, adding contrast to the scene. The background is plain, focusing attention on the fauna depicted. The style appears to be a traditional, scientific illustration for educational or reference purposes.

artworks.title: Grus Americana, alta major
artworks.artist: Johann Michael Seligmann after George Edwards
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crane near vegetation. The image shows a large crane with detailed feathers in various shades of gray. The crane has a long neck and its head features a combination of red and white. The bird's legs are long and slender. In the background, there is lush green plant life and hints of foliage in darker shades.
